Original source rationale: Per Rule XII, Sec. 1207(2)(c), if only two exits are required, they shall be placed a distance apart of not less than one-fifth (1/5) of the perimeter of the area served, measured in a straight line between exits. The 1/2 diagonal rule belongs to IBC and RA 9514 (Fire Code) — NOT PD 1096. This is a critical exam trap.
